page_description: Diagnose, plan, test, gate and record candidate specs; the planner is owner-granted only and stays honestly not configured otherwise.

Seven labeled suites with deterministic scoring, markdown export and provenance; live model runs need an owner-attached runner.
Measured-only latency and token telemetry; TTFT is streaming-only and energy is refused without a real hardware meter.
Honest per-engine states; cloud engines need explicit consent, optional engines need measured RAM and owner opt-in, downloads are refused.
